# Getting Help

## Discord (questions, usage, discussion)

Join the [TRaSH Guides Discord](https://trash-guides.info/discord) and head to **[#tagarr](https://discordapp.com/channels/492590071455940612/1495686165741703229)** under Community Apps. This is the best place for:

- Usage questions
- Help writing filter rules / release-group configs
- Feature requests
- Discussion about tagging strategies

## GitHub Issues (bugs)

[File a bug report](https://github.com/prophetse7en/tagarr/issues/new) if you hit a reproducible problem. Please include:

- Script name + version (shown in log output, e.g. `Tagarr Import v1.6.0`)
- Radarr/Sonarr version
- Relevant log excerpt (`logs/tagarr_*.log`)
- Steps to reproduce

Dry-run output is especially useful — all scripts default to dry-run mode and the output shows exactly what the script was going to do.
